scope: Twenty serial real embedded-CPython queue delivery fixtures, ten per matched CPython 3.14.5 threading ABI, on macOS ARM64 with fresh private SQLite state. The exact command selects the dedicated delivery child. Its successful return requires all decision/retry, business receipt, cancellation/authority, backpressure, preserving restart, joined native report and settled accounting assertions. No failure reproduces; this supplies regression evidence without explaining the historical Linux deadline.
